title: Sales call in English with Hebrew phrases

lines.text: שלום, thanks for joining. We want to talk about the yearly plan.
lines.name: Avi

lines.text: Sure Avi. The yearly plan is 8400 dollars for the whole team.
זה יקר קצת. Our budget is 7000 for this year.

lines.text: I can check with my manager about a discount and reply by Monday.

lines.text: כן, יש export לאקסל. I will send you a sample report tomorrow.
We decided to start with the monthly plan for two months.

lines.text: איך עובד התשלום, by card or by invoice?
lines.name: Avi

lines.text: I worry the training will take too long for the staff.
